_purpose: The major medical meetings where pivotal and late-breaking data lands. Big companies often announce a presentation by press release only (MRNA, 2026-09-21), which scripts/readout-sweep.mjs cannot see, so bench-weekly-catalyst web-checks every meeting starting inside 75 days for presenting companies. Added 2026-10-11 at Adam's yes.
_rule: verified = dates read from the organiser or two independent listings. The Sunday routine re-verifies any 'unverified' row inside 120 days and adds the next year's meeting when one passes. Never trade off a meeting date alone - the catalyst is a company's presentation slot, logged with log-catalyst.mjs --type readout.
